title: Oct 7 Results + Oct 8 Preview: When the Model Keeps the Faith
summary: A tough 1-3 day, but here's why we're not backing down from tomorrow's White Sox pick

content.value:
## Here's the Thing About Rough Days

Look, I'm not going to sugarcoat it—October 7th was a grind. We went 1-3, hitting on just 25% of our picks. The kind of day where you check your phone hoping the scores changed, but they didn't. The Dodgers showed up for us against the Braves, but the Sox, Yankees, and Padres? Not so much.

But here's what I've learned covering this game: baseball has a way of humbling you right before it reminds you why you fell in love with it in the first place.

## The Silver Lining in the Storm

The Dodgers pick was our winner, and honestly, it felt good to watch them execute. At 51% confidence, it wasn't our strongest conviction play, but the model saw something in the matchup that played out on the field.

The other three? They all felt reasonable at the time. The Padres at 54% seemed like the safest bet of the day, and yet baseball reminded us there's no such thing as safe. That's the beauty and the frustration of this game wrapped into one box score.

## Tomorrow's Story: White Sox Get Another Shot

Here's where it gets interesting. Our top pick for October 8th? The Chicago White Sox again, hosting those same Cleveland Guardians. I know what you're thinking—didn't we just lose that pick yesterday?

Yes. Yes we did.

But the model is telling us something. At 50% confidence, this is essentially a coin flip, but the pitching matchup has shifted. Parker Messick gets the ball for Cleveland, while Hagen Smith takes the mound for Chicago. The model sees value in backing the home team again, and sometimes in baseball, the second chance is the charm.

## The Pitcher's Duel to Watch

Parker Messick versus Hagen Smith isn't going to make the ESPN highlight packages, but these matchups matter. The model's looking at recent form, home/away splits, and how each pitcher has fared in similar situations. At 50%, we're not screaming this pick from the rooftops, but we're confident enough to make it our top play for tomorrow.

Sometimes the best stories come from doubling down when it matters most.

## The Road Ahead

A 1-3 day stings. There's no getting around that. But if you've followed baseball long enough, you know that variance is part of the deal. The model doesn't get emotional, it doesn't second-guess, and it doesn't let one bad day define the next one.

Tomorrow, we reset. The White Sox get another chance to prove the model right, and we get another chance to find that winning feeling. That's the thing about this game—there's always tomorrow, and tomorrow always brings another story to tell.

Let's see if the White Sox can flip the script.
